# Design QA

Shared references at `../_visualforge-shared/references/`. Use them when needed.

## Global quality rules

- Read `anti-slop-design-rubric.md` (the contradiction and risk-fit tests are central here).
- Use `opinionated-decision-template.md`.
- This subskill is a gate — if any audit fails, block completion until fixed.
- Output an actionable report, not a vague pass.
- Maintain `decision-log.md`.

## Purpose

The final pass before the orchestrator declares the design system done. Nothing escapes this subskill without explicit acceptance: every doc reviewed, every contradiction surfaced, every slop instance removed, every gate verified.

## Mode-aware behavior

- All modes run the full QA pass.
- Retrofit mode additionally audits the drift report and migration plan for completeness.

## Inputs

- Every other VisualForge doc.
- Every token file.
- Figma build log.
- Decision log.
- Research ledger.

## Output files

- `docs/design-system/07-quality/design-qa-report.md`
- `docs/design-system/auditability/design-quality-review.md`
- `docs/design-system/00-index.md` — regenerated by this subskill at the end of the run with the full current file map.
- `docs/design-system/WHATS-MISSING.md` — regenerated by this subskill: deferred decisions, unbuilt components, screens referenced but not specced, tokens referenced but missing, pressure-test FIX-NEXT and WATCH findings, persona walkthroughs not run, subskills not yet run, backend gaps. Single page stakeholders read to know what's outstanding.
- Decision-log entries (DEC-985 to DEC-999) per `../_visualforge-shared/references/decision-id-allocation.md`. Overflow into retrofit or pressure-test ranges if needed.

## Audit passes

### Pass 1 — Coverage audit

Every required doc exists at its organized path, every required section populated:

**Root**
- `README.md`, `RULES.md`, `00-index.md`.

**01-foundations/**
- `design-brief.md`, `competitive-audit.md`, `design-trends-research.md`.
- `personas/_index.md` plus one `persona-[slug].md` per persona.

**02-visual-language/**
- `brand-identity.md`, `design-tokens.md`, `surface-treatments.md`, `iconography.md`.

**03-structure/**
- `information-architecture.md`, `layout-system.md`, `site-map.md`.

**04-interaction/**
- `ux-flows.md`, `content-design.md`, `micro-interactions.md`, `scroll-and-gesture.md`, `imagery-illustration.md`, `motion-design.md`.

**05-components/**
- `overview.md`, `_index.md`, plus one file per component under `primitives/`, `composites/`, `patterns/`, `domain/`.

**06-screens/**
- `_index.md`, plus one `SCR-NNN-[slug].md` per screen.

**07-quality/**
- `accessibility-contract.md`, `frontend-implementation-contract.md`, `design-qa-report.md`.

**auditability/**
- `mode-report.md`, `decision-log.md`, `research-ledger.md`, `design-quality-review.md`, `figma-build-log.md`, `rules-update-log.md`.

**tokens/**
- `tokens.json` (canonical), plus generated `tokens.css`, `tokens.ts`, `tokens.figma.json`.

**Supporting**
- `content/microcopy.json`, `icons/semantic-map.md`, `imagery/style-guide.md`, `brand/mood-board.md`.

**Retrofit (when applicable)**
- `retrofit/inventory.md`, `data-inventory.md`, `data-crosswalk.md`, `backend-gaps.md`, `missing-surfaces.md`, `ia-restructuring.md`, `drift-report.md`, `migration-plan.md`.

**Flat-dump check:** no file at `docs/design-system/` root other than `README.md`, `RULES.md`, `00-index.md`. Personas, components, screens must each be one-file-per-thing — never lumped.

Result: pass / list of missing.

### Pass 2 — Slop audit

Run `anti-slop-design-rubric.md` checks across every doc:

- Search for taste-words without values: `modern`, `clean`, `minimal`, `intuitive`, `seamless`, `delightful`, `professional`, `user-friendly`, `sleek`, `elegant`, `polished`, `vibrant`, `premium`, `pixel-perfect`, `beautiful`, `smooth`, `subtle`, `pop`, `nice`, `consider`, `feels`.
- For each hit: verify the surrounding context provides concrete behavior. Fix or flag.
- Verify every color statement has hex/HSL/OKLCH values.
- Verify every animation statement has duration + easing.
- Verify every shadow has layer composition.
- Verify every component state is enumerated.
- Verify every trend has trend-fit test.

Result: list of slop hits with locations; fix or document.

### Pass 3 — Contradiction sweep

Compare:

- Brand identity ↔ design tokens (do tokens express the attributes?).
- Design tokens ↔ surface treatments (do surface recipes use defined tokens?).
- Design tokens ↔ component system (are all token references valid?).
- Component system ↔ UX flows (does every screen's components exist?).
- UX flows ↔ IA (do flows align with nav model?).
- Layout system ↔ component system (do components fit grid?).
- Motion ↔ accessibility (reduced-motion fallback for every motion?).
- Surface treatments ↔ accessibility (reduce-transparency fallback for every glass?).
- Content design ↔ component system (every component's text uses microcopy?).
- Iconography ↔ component system (every icon in semantic map?).
- Frontend contract ↔ design tokens (token pipeline can produce all formats?).
- Figma build ↔ docs (every doc value mirrored in Figma?).
- Retrofit drift report ↔ ideal docs (every drift covered?).

For each contradiction: locate, fix, log.

### Pass 4 — Token integrity

Run `scripts/validate_design_docs.py`:

- All Tier 2 tokens resolve.
- All Tier 3 tokens resolve.
- No orphan tokens.
- No raw values in component docs.
- All four token export formats present and equivalent.
- Light + dark variants for all semantic tokens.
- Contrast verification table passes target a11y level.

### Pass 5 — Accessibility audit

- Level lock recorded.
- Keyboard map covers all interactive elements.
- Screen reader contract per component.
- Focus management rules per modal / popover / drawer.
- Touch / pointer target compliance.
- Reduced-motion / reduced-transparency / high-contrast contracts.
- Content design avoids inaccessible language patterns (color-only, "click here").
- Forms accessibility patterns documented.

### Pass 6 — Performance review

- Performance budgets numeric and tied to design choices.
- Surface treatments fit budget (shadow layer count, blur effect cost).
- Motion fits frame budget.
- Image strategy fits image budget.
- Font strategy fits font budget.

### Pass 7 — Risk fit

- Regulated domain detected → stricter constraints in place.
- Accessibility-critical product → AAA target or AA+ with explicit AAA criteria adopted.
- Children's / vulnerable users → motion, contrast, dark-pattern checks.
- AI features → disclosure, source citing, generated-content chrome.

### Pass 8 — Figma parity

- If MCP path was used: every token, style, component, screen present in Figma.
- If fallback path: every artifact in `figma-import-bundle/` and instructions complete.

### Pass 9 — Drift / retrofit audit (retrofit mode)

- Every existing inventory item appears in drift report.
- Every drift has migration plan or Temporary decision.
- Migration plan ordered safely (Phase 0 ships zero pixel changes).
- Reversal triggers defined.
- **Data inventory present** (`retrofit/data-inventory.md`) with every entity classified.
- **Data crosswalk built** — every screen spec references entity.field paths from the inventory.
- **No invented fields:** every field in a screen spec exists in `data-inventory.md` OR has a `BackendGap` entry in `retrofit/backend-gaps.md`.
- **No missed entities:** every entity in `data-inventory.md` either appears in a screen spec OR has a documented operational-only justification OR appears in `retrofit/missing-surfaces.md`.
- **IA restructuring report present** (`retrofit/ia-restructuring.md`) with findings across all seven categories (split / merge / missing / misplaced / orphan / dead-end / role-leak), each either accepted (cascaded into ideal IA + migration plan), deferred (in `auditability/deferred-findings.md`), or rejected (in `auditability/rejected-findings.md`).
- Sensitive fields from the data inventory have explicit design treatment recorded in the accessibility / privacy section.

### Pass 10 — Decision log integrity

- Every DEC-NNN ID unique.
- Every DEC-NNN within its allocated range per `_visualforge-shared/references/decision-id-allocation.md`.
- Every decision uses the opinionated decision template.
- Every decision has source, alternatives, recommendation, confidence, bindings, reversal trigger.
- No decisions marked "TBD" or "TODO".
- Terminal-evidence files preserved (decision-log / research-ledger / pressure-test-iterations append-only).

### Pass 11 — Implementation safety contract

Per `_visualforge-shared/references/implementation-safety-contract.md`:

- Every component spec has exact import path, file location, allowed and forbidden dependencies.
- Every screen has route + file location + auth guard reference.
- Every token has explicit allowed-consumer tier rules.
- Every subskill narrative has the "What we are NOT doing in this layer" section.
- No forbidden ambiguous phrases ("consider", "as needed", "appropriate", "modern", etc.) in any generated doc.

### Pass 12 — Idempotency + cascade lifecycle

Per `_visualforge-shared/references/regeneration-and-cascade-lifecycle.md`:

- Concurrency lock file exists and is owned by this run.
- Derived token files are equivalent to canonical `tokens.json`.
- `_index.md` files reflect current state.
- `00-index.md` regenerated.
- `WHATS-MISSING.md` regenerated.
- No append-only file was overwritten (verify by line-count growth or git diff).

## QA report structure

`docs/design-system/20-design-qa-report.md`:

```markdown
# Design QA Report

## Overall result
PASS | PASS WITH NOTES | FAIL

## Pass-by-pass results
- Coverage audit: PASS / FAIL (with list of gaps)
- Slop audit: PASS / FAIL (with hits)
- Contradiction sweep: PASS / FAIL (with contradictions)
- Token integrity (incl. property-based tests): PASS / FAIL (validation script output)
- Accessibility audit: PASS / FAIL (with criteria failing)
- Performance review: PASS / FAIL (with budget overshoots)
- Risk fit: PASS / FAIL (with risks not addressed)
- Figma parity: PASS / FAIL (with mismatches)
- Drift / retrofit audit: N/A or PASS / FAIL
- Decision log integrity: PASS / FAIL
- Implementation safety contract: PASS / FAIL (forbidden-phrase scan, import-path coverage)
- Idempotency + cascade lifecycle: PASS / FAIL (lock owned, derived files current, append-only preserved)

## Required fixes (if FAIL)
- [item with location and proposed fix]

## Optional improvements (recommendations)
- [item]

## Test plan handoff
- Visual regression: [test setup recommendation]
- a11y testing: [test setup recommendation]
- Performance testing: [test setup recommendation]
- User testing: [recommended unmoderated tasks tied to top flows]

## Sign-off requirements
- [list of stakeholders / roles whose sign-off the team should secure before launch — e.g., legal for regulated, product owner for scope, eng lead for budget feasibility]
```

## Relationship to design-pressure-test

This subskill audits **documentation completeness and structural integrity**: are all required files present, do tokens resolve, are there contradictions, is anything slop?

The follow-on subskill `visualforge-design-pressure-test` audits **design quality itself**: heuristic evaluation, persona walkthroughs, edge cases, adversarial use, cognitive load, brand coherence, feasibility, future-shift robustness.

Both are required. PASS here does not mean the design is good — it means the documentation is complete and consistent. The pressure-test follows.

## Quality gate

The orchestrator cannot declare completion unless this subskill returns PASS or PASS WITH NOTES (with notes explicitly accepted by user), AND `visualforge-design-pressure-test` returns GOOD or GOOD WITH NOTES.

## Anti-slop QA rules

- A QA pass that finds zero issues is suspicious — re-run with more rigor.
- "Looks good" without per-pass validation fails.
- Auto-fixing without recording in decision-log fails traceability.
- Skipping a pass because "it'll probably be fine" fails — passes are required.

## Sources and basis

This subskill's checks are derived from `anti-slop-design-rubric.md`, `design-decision-quality-protocol.md`, `token-artifact-export-spec.md`, and WCAG 2.2.
